about: Client parity cases: the Python package (python/tests/test_client_parity.py) and the npm package's embedded engine (js/test/parity.test.ts) run each case and compare the Arrow result, canonicalized as README.md describes, with `expected`. `{root}` is the repository root.

cases.name: parquet_scalar_types
cases.source: pyarrow 26.0.1 read of the fixture (independent reader)
cases.sql: SELECT i32, i64, f64, dec, d, ts, s, b, flag FROM parquet.`{root}/tests/fixtures/parquet/pyarrow_snappy.parquet` WHERE i32 <= -1497 ORDER BY i32

cases.name: parquet_null_counts
cases.source: pyarrow 26.0.1 read of the fixture (independent reader)
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, count(i32) AS non_null FROM parquet.`{root}/tests/fixtures/parquet/pyarrow_snappy.parquet`

cases.name: csv_with_schema
setup: CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW parity_people (id INT, name STRING, score DOUBLE, joined DATE, active BOOLEAN) USING csv OPTIONS (path '{root}/tests/fixtures/client-parity/people.csv', header 'true')
cases.sql: SELECT id, name, score, joined, active FROM parity_people ORDER BY id

cases.name: json_nested_inferred
cases.source: hand-written fixture events.jsonl; Spark's JSON inference sorts the fields and reads integers as bigint

cases.name: delta_column_mapping
cases.sql: SELECT id, a2, s, p, b FROM delta.`{root}/tests/fixtures/delta-4.4.1/column-mapping-id` ORDER BY id
